name: Multi-view Consistent Densification
definition: A densification strategy that reduces Gaussian redundancy by evaluating multi-view consistency. It identifies Gaussians lying in regions of poor reconstruction quality across multiple sampled views, rather than relying solely on image-space gradient magnitude.
summary: Multi-view Consistent Densification identifies primitives for densification based on reconstruction errors across multiple camera views, reducing redundancy by ensuring new primitives spawn only where current representations fail across viewpoints.
